about.label: MISSION
about.title: About us
about.subtitle:
Goro Muluwongel Church is a Gospel-centred Christian community committed to worshipping God, proclaiming the Gospel of Jesus Christ, and helping people grow in faith. Through worship, discipleship, fellowship, teaching, and community service, we seek to create an environment where individuals and families can encounter Christ and grow together.

Our ministry is built on biblical teaching, prayer, fellowship, and practical service. We believe that the church is not only a place of worship but also a community where believers support one another and extend God's love to those around them.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.heading: Our vision
vision.body:
To build a Christ-centred church that faithfully proclaims the Gospel, nurtures spiritual growth, strengthens families, and serves the community with love, compassion, and integrity.

We envision a growing and united church where every believer is encouraged to discover their God-given purpose, actively participate in ministry, and become a faithful witness of Christ in their families, workplaces, and communities.

items.title: Community Outreach
items.text: Supporting people and families through practical assistance and Gospel-centred outreach.

items.title: Youth Development
items.text: Creating opportunities for young people to grow spiritually, develop their talents, and participate in church ministry.

items.title: Children's Ministry
items.text: Supporting children through biblical teaching, discipleship, and a safe environment for spiritual growth.
